set.body:
Outcome

Return authoritative sample-keyed predictive outputs.

Acceptance

- ExactOnce yields one and only one OOF output per SampleId in source order.
- Duplicate, missing, foreign, or reordered outputs fail closed.
- Prediction, score, fold, preparation, and model receipts remain linked.
- Summary metrics derive from typed predictions rather than replacing them.
set.title: P4A.5: reconstruct exact out-of-fold predictions on the sample axis
